choices.reason: Retain the paper's calibrated planned Welch comparisons over raw-score and robustness variants; the earlier rules leave several AI arms eligible. C3 provides access throughout all task stages without the additional warning, making it closest to free use of a general chatbot against the shared C4 control.

choices.reason: The unadjusted Welch contrasts C1-C2, C3-C1, C5-C1 and C3-C5 are all primary planned comparisons; preferring them to the task-adjusted warning specification does not select one contrast. The abstract and introduction do not report a unique pairwise AI-design contrast, and no later rule uniquely separates these task-pooled, single-session comparisons with different controls.
